Construct path to cached result for the calling function

Source: R/cache.R
construct_cache_file_path.Rd

Construct path to cached result for the calling function

Usage

construct_cache_file_path(n_frames_up = 1)

Arguments

n_frames_up

Default is 1, which is to say: a path is constructed using the name and the arguments of the function calling construct_cache_file_path(). If n_frames_up = 2, a path is constructed using the name and the arguments of the function calling the function calling construct_cache_file_path(),.

Value

A file path to a .rds file in the /derived subdirectory of the directory in which are stored the eHARS data currently being used within the R session. The file ame is constructed as <function name>__<function argument names and values separated by '_'/'__'>

Examples

test_fun <- function(x = 1, y = 2, z = 3){construct_cache_file_path()}
test_fun()
#> Error in construct_cache_file_path(): could not find function "construct_cache_file_path"
rm(test_fun)
